diagnosis_narrative: Yes, the current validation set is overwhelmingly a random split of the same repositories and commits present in the training set. Specifically, 825 out of 829 validation projects (99.52%) and 23,640 out of 23,648 validation samples (99.97%) come from projects in the training set. Furthermore, 4,633 out of 6,231 validation commits (74.35%) are directly present in the training set. Because the model was trained on functions from the exact same repositories and commits, validation evaluates in-distribution memorization rather than cross-project generalization to unseen codebases.
